turns.user: My cover started on 20 May 2026. I've a consultant appointment on 17 November, so I'll be out of the waiting period by then, won't I?
turns.reply: No. With your cover starting on 20 May, 17 November is day 181, and the waiting period ends on day 182, 18 November. Consultant treatment on 17 November isn’t covered by the waiting-period rule; treatment on 18 November or later is covered, subject to the usual limits.
